reviews.title: Great staff
reviews.text: The staff were very friendly and could speak and understand English. The boarding was effortless and wouldn’t know it was a budget airline. I would highly recommend this airline
reviews.author: Paul C

reviews.title: Taipei Songshan Airport to Penghu for the day
reviews.text: Clean and well-maintained aircraft. Great way to visit Penghu for an adventure for the day, several flight schedule options. Will definitely fly this airline again 😊
reviews.author: Mark P

reviews.title: Great flight
reviews.text: I needed to travel on a particular morning from Hualien to Taipei but all the train tickets were not available. So booked the flight for 888 twd ( which is about £24 sterling). Modern Hualien Airport was practically deserted when I got there in the morning and so check-in was quick. The actual flight took no more than 30 mins. We landed at Taipei Sung Shan airport and within a very short time, I was on the MRT. Quick, pleasant, inexpensive flight and the clean airports were not crowded at all.
reviews.author: Fortynineplus

reviews.title: Very good for a regional airline
reviews.text: The flight from Taipei to Hualien is about 50 minutes. Plane was a turbo prop ATR72. Quite nest, clean & comfortable. Flight attendants were very good. Pilit was great in the turbulent rainy weather. Flight service consists of a cold apple juice popper. Overall a good experience but when you take waitind times & processing into consideration, probably best to take the train
reviews.author: Doc1964001

reviews.title: Cannot modify any mistake after online booking.
reviews.text: I did online booking from Taipei To Taitung last week to fly in March. But because of Google Chrome Auto Fill so some mistake in passport Number happen (other information such as name and surname is correct). I email my name and booking number and passport to them to tell them to modify the passport number for me. They said that it cannot be modify and push mo to buy a new ticket.
reviews.author: Sam

reviews.title: First Time Flight
reviews.text: I flew Uni air for the first time from Taipei Songshan to Shanghai Pudong. Check in was with EVA. Everything from the ticket, the gate, and to the plane was co-branded with Eva Airlines so it was not obvious that Uni was a different airline. The one major negative was that Uni does not recognize Star Alliance Gold status so no lounge access, no mileage accrual and no priority boarding. To get to UNI’s boarding gate 4, I took a little walk to the farthest end of the main terminal. As part of boarding group 4 there was just enough luggage space available when I finally boarded. Seats were typical economy width and comfort. Service on the plane was very good a la EVA air style. I skipped breakfast but my neighbor’s meal looked decent. Overall a good experience but in the future I will ensure that I am only flying an EVA air designated flight.
reviews.author: TheLeongOhana

reviews.title: A day tour to Taroko Gorge.
reviews.text: Early morning flight to Hualien (return same day-evening) to the see the Taroko Gorge. Uni Air was a brilliant flight on a ATR aircraft. Great service. Very quick flight of 35 mins. you only great a water.
reviews.author: mikeadey72

reviews.title: Thanks！
reviews.text: Good service. Thanks for this flight experience. 很感謝立榮航空的服務, 這是一個非常棒的經驗, 感謝空服員的細心照料, 最後希望能夠增加會員的里程數！感激不盡！
reviews.author: Clare C

reviews.title: Nice fly
reviews.text: Overall, it was a great fly. Check in was smooth. We were able to do the check in at Taipei MRT main station so we didn't have to carry the suitcases all the way to the airport. That was very nice. Flight crew was very friendly and helpful. Service was good. They provided snack sandwich even though it was only couple hours flight.
reviews.author: calvin722

reviews.title: Friendly staff, efficient journey
reviews.text: We had wanted to travel from Taipei to Hualien by train in order to visit the Taroko Gorge but no tickets were available online. So we did the next best thing by flying there. At twice the cost of a train ticket (we got discounted tickets) and half the time, I'm surprised more folks don't consider this option. Anyhow, things were friendly all round from ground service to flight crew. Our ATR-72 plane was fun to travel on, considering we hardly ever get to fly by turboprop. Inflight service consisted of a packet drink (apple juice or oolong tea) which was fine considering the flight was only less than an hour long. Overall, a pleasant experience.
reviews.author: ianwyj

reviews.title: A321, no seatback screen.
reviews.text: Great product for a regional airline. It is part of the EVA Air. Spacious legroom for economy. No personal seatback screen, only overhead screen.
reviews.author: RBiename

reviews.title: Clean and comfotable
reviews.text: The check in process is amazing fast, and the customer service is excellent. Boarding is so easy, and the plane itself is very clean and new. On board beverage is provided, and the broadcast announcement is clear and easy to understand.
reviews.author: Richard L

reviews.title: Much too late ... not sure whose error this was actually
reviews.text: We arrived just in time to the airport in Taipei, checked in and passed the security to arrive exactly at the time when boarding should start. This was all quite fine, beside the long line on the check in counter. But then we had to wait for a long time in front of the gate. It seems that a flight before us was delayed and caused our delay. In the end we arrived approx. 2 hours late in Wuxi and I am wondering why the did not just changed our gate (anyway they brought us to the aircraft by bus).
reviews.author: Ralph W

reviews.title: Standard airline - everything went fine
reviews.text: This flight was quite fine. Event I though we will not do it in time, as the check in counter just opened 1:20 hr before flight and there was a loooong line. But we took-off in time, the flight was smooth and even the food was good. The service was standard but the staff very friendly
reviews.author: Ralph W

reviews.title: Excellent Taiwan Domestic Flight
reviews.text: Great domestic flight. Actually I have being travel with Uni Air for two trips which are from Taichung to Makung and from Makung to Kaohsiung. Both flights are satisfactory, reasonable ticket price with newly ATR 72-600 plane. Cabin is clean, legroom space is decent. I was so surprise that just a short flight (about 30 - 40 mins) and Uni Air has provided free in flight drinks! There is no IFE provided due to short trip but there is a in flight magazine in each of the seat. Taichung and Makung Airport check in process is fast, check in staff is friendly and helpful. Another thing has to be highlight was once we received our check in baggage in the destination airport, the group staff will need you to submit the baggage tag to them and double confirm we collect the right baggage. This is a valued added service that can avoid other passenger wrongly take our baggage.
reviews.author: calvin289
